sentences.en: A: Hi, Tom. Do you have any plans for this weekend?
sentences.cn: A：嗨，汤姆。这个周末有什么计划吗？

sentences.en: B: Not yet. I was thinking about going hiking. Would you like to join me?
sentences.cn: B：还没有。我在想去徒步。你想一起来吗？

sentences.en: A: That sounds great! Where shall we go?
sentences.cn: A：听起来不错！我们去哪儿？

sentences.en: B: How about Green Mountain? The view there is amazing in spring.
sentences.cn: B：青山怎么样？那里春天的风景很美。

sentences.en: A: Perfect. What time should we meet?
sentences.cn: A：太好了。我们几点碰面？

sentences.en: B: Let's meet at the school gate at eight in the morning.
sentences.cn: B：早上八点在学校门口见吧。

sentences.en: A: OK. Don't forget to bring some water and snacks.
sentences.cn: A：好的。别忘了带些水和零食。

questions.q: What will they probably do this weekend? (go ______)
Where will they meet? (at the school ______)
What time will they meet? (用数字，英文单词皆可)

sentences.en: A: Excuse me, could you tell me how to get to the library?
sentences.cn: A：打扰一下，你能告诉我怎么去图书馆吗？

sentences.en: B: Sure. Go straight ahead and turn left at the second crossing.
sentences.cn: B：当然。一直往前走，在第二个路口左转。

sentences.en: A: Turn left at the second crossing. And then?
sentences.cn: A：在第二个路口左转。然后呢？

sentences.en: B: The library is on your right, next to the bank.
sentences.cn: B：图书馆在你右手边，银行旁边。

sentences.en: A: Is it far from here?
sentences.cn: A：离这儿远吗？

sentences.en: B: No, it's about five minutes' walk.
sentences.cn: B：不远，大约步行五分钟。

sentences.en: A: Thank you so much for your help!
sentences.cn: A：非常感谢你的帮助！

questions.q: Where does A want to go? (the ______)
questions.tip: how to get to the library

questions.q: Where should A turn left? (at the second ______)
questions.tip: turn left at the second crossing

questions.q: How long does it take to walk there? (about ______ minutes)

sentences.en: Good afternoon, everyone. Here is an important announcement.
sentences.cn: 大家下午好。这里有一则重要通知。

sentences.en: Our school will hold an English Speech Contest next Friday.
sentences.cn: 我们学校将于下周五举办英语演讲比赛。

sentences.en: The contest will take place in the school hall at two o'clock.
sentences.cn: 比赛将于下午两点在学校礼堂举行。

sentences.en: All students who are interested are welcome to sign up.
sentences.cn: 欢迎所有感兴趣的同学报名。

sentences.en: Please give your name to your English teacher before Wednesday.
sentences.cn: 请在周三前把名字报给你的英语老师。

sentences.en: The topic of this year's contest is "My Dream".
sentences.cn: 今年比赛的主题是“我的梦想”。

sentences.en: We look forward to your active participation. Thank you!
sentences.cn: 我们期待你的积极参与。谢谢！

questions.q: What contest will the school hold? (English Speech ______)
Where will the contest take place? (the school ______)
What is the topic of the contest? (My ______)
